literal_meaning: every trick's master (referring to a versatile but superficially knowledgeable person, possibly derived from 'har' meaning every and 'moula' meaning scholar or master)
figurative_meaning_en: sarcastically, a know-it-all; judge in all matters
similar_in_english: jack of all trades, master of none
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা হরফুনমৌলা, সব বিষয়ে তার মতামত আছে।
গ্রামের হরফুনমৌলা বলল, এই কাজটা এভাবে করতে হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a harfunnamoula, he has an opinion on everything.
The village harfunnamoula said, this task must be done this way.
note: The term likely draws from the image of a meddlesome village mullah or scholar in Bengali society.
